forum.title: FLASH_OB_DisableWRP bug
forum.best_answer_content:
*> OB->WRP0 |= WRP0\_Data;*

*> OB->WRP1 |= WRP1\_Data;*

*> OB->WRP2 |= WRP2\_Data;*

*> OB->WRP3 |= WRP3\_Data;*

These lines don't appear in the latest stm32f1xx\_hal\_flash\_ex.c file:

<https://github.com/STMicroelectronics/stm32f1xx-hal-driver/blob/fee494a92b5ad331f92ad21f76c66a5cb83773ee/Src/stm32f1xx_hal_flash_ex.c#L762>

You're probably on an older version which has since been fixed.

It looks like this was fixed 4 months ago:

[[HAL][FLASH] Fix incorrect write protection in OB->WRPx due to OR (|)… · STMicroelectronics/stm32f1xx-hal-driver@c9c90c2](https://github.com/STMicroelectronics/stm32f1xx-hal-driver/commit/c9c90c2e69578405729cfc8f26cdcb9ff49b3522)

It'll get pushed to STM32CubeMX files whenever they make a new release.
